responsibilies: Developed an analytics tracker and dashboard to surface user insights, built with TypeScript, Web APIs, Express.js, Node.js, React, and Chart.js.
Implemented an auth server with role-based access control (RBAC) that scales accordingly, using JWT, Python, FastAPI, and Argon2id.
